sloka: मम रूपं च सम्प्रेक्ष्य वने विचरतो महत् ।राक्षस्यो भयवित्रस्ता भवेयुर्विकृताननाः ।। ५.३०.२५।।।।
transliteration: mama rūpaṁ ca samprekṣya vane vicarato mahat ।rākṣasyo bhayavitrastā bhaveyurvikṛtānanāḥ ।। 5.30.25।।।।

translations.english: "These ogresses with their hideous faces will be frightened on looking at my huge form moving in this grove.
